# Where do the XERJ benchmark numbers come from?

Every number on this page comes from `demo/playbooks/BENCHMARK_VS_ES.md` and the
migration recipe table at `docs/recipes/migrate-from-elasticsearch.md:214`.

You can reproduce the whole board in four commands on your own machine, and an
unexpected LOSE fails CI, so the figures cannot drift.

Under sustained write, Elasticsearch holds p99 at 2-19 ms while XERJ rises to
60-150 ms on a single-node box.
